name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
verdict: A brand of Luz Saúde, controlled by Fidelidade (Fosun 84.9892%, state-owned CGD a passive 15%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: chain is Hospital da Luz (brand) -> Luz Saúde, S.A. -> Fidelidade (majority; 40% to Macquarie's MEIF 7 since Jan 2026) -> Fosun International 84.9892% / CGD 15%. The 15% CGD stake is below the 5%-rule only by being state-linked: state ownership alone is not a tier, and no sourced serious-abuse record was found for the chain. Nothing sourced passes the test.
